{
 "study": "Saslow LR et al. 2023",
 "design": "2x2 factorial",
 "country": "USA",
 "duration": "4 months",
 "n_randomized_total": "83",
 "experimental_arm": {
  "label": "very low-carbohydrate (VLC)",
  "intervention_description": "very low-carbohydrate diet, decreasing carbohydrate intake to 20 to 35 g of net carbohydrates per day, with goal of achieving nutritional ketosis (positive urine dipstick result)",
  "n_randomized": "25",
  "n_analyzed": "41",
  "hba1c_change_mean": "-0.32",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion": "0.07",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion_type": "SE",
  "hba1c_baseline_mean": "6.09",
  "hba1c_baseline_sd": "0.07",
  "hba1c_final_mean": "5.74",
  "hba1c_final_sd": "0.08"
 },
 "control_arm": {
  "label": "DASH",
  "intervention_description": "Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension (DASH) diet, limiting sodium to <2,300 mg daily and fat intake to 20-30% of calories per day",
  "n_randomized": "25",
  "n_analyzed": "41",
  "hba1c_change_mean": "-0.14",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion": "0.07",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion_type": "SE",
  "hba1c_baseline_mean": "6.10",
  "hba1c_baseline_sd": "0.07",
  "hba1c_final_mean": "5.97",
  "hba1c_final_sd": "0.07"
 }
}
